mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a covenant that should not be broken for no justifiable reason."
Marriage in Islam is a covenant that should not be broken for no justifiable reason.

Death is an inevitable occurrence which man must experience and when this happens he leaves all his properties behind little or big to be inherited.

Sabians are the communities who do not have any particular religion.

Half is the share of the only daughter if there is no son sharing with her.

Family planning and birth control is a controversial issue in Islam.

Marriage is a means to emotional and sexual satisfaction.
